cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

mechanism: A manages the helper's presence as a professional process until A can face the next task alone.
confusable: General delay differs from keeping B until A reaches an explicitly legible point of steadiness.
comparison: Hospital disclosure needs rehearsal before facing children; a new flat requires tolerating being alone.
seedUse: Keep the operation and new-flat contexts; replace generic expertise with corrections of B's supporting technique.
